preflight.note: Created before replacing the interim RepoPact commit pin with the formal 2.2.0 PyPI release.

acceptance_criteria.text: ForgeLink replaces the interim git commit dependency with exact PyPI pin repopact==2.2.0 and aligns governing documentation.
Public PyPI metadata and the upstream v2.2.0 tag identify the dashboard-integrity release and its published artifacts.
Canonical dashboard generation, ForgeLink governance validation, and the complete pre-push gate pass with RepoPact 2.2.0 installed.
The formal-release adoption is recorded with reproducible evidence and the work ledger is reconciled.
